text: BAM share rose 0.12 percentage points over 23 hours to 32.8%, while the 7 day move remains a 0.02 percentage point decline. Leadership remains whale-driven: ams-mainnet-bam-dev is largest at 23.7% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3, so concentration is elevated. The busiest node is in fra with 96 validators, which points to routing concentration rather than validator churn.
